description: Full working Telugu dictionary extracted from installed Tesseract OCR Telugu traineddata word DAWGs, filtered to clean Telugu Unicode tokens. Used only to validate non-core lexical bases/stems; core bases remain hard-coded.
format: one NFC-normalized Telugu token per line in lexicon_full.txt
filter: keeps only Telugu Unicode block characters plus ZWNJ/ZWJ; excludes punctuation, Latin, digits, mixed fragments, and tokens over 60 code points
caveat: This is a full working word dictionary, not a pure lemma-only WordNet. It may include inflected surface forms. The parser therefore ranks rule-based base+modifier analyses before exact dictionary standalones.

v16_supplement.caveat: v16 supplement is an auditable corpus-diagnostic candidate layer, not a replacement for an independently curated WordNet-style lemma dictionary. It is kept as separate files and exact standalone hits remain lower priority than valid modifier-chain parses.
